abstract: The cytotoxicity of methotrexate (MTX) and actinomycin-D (Act-D), and the influence of Citrovorum factor on MTX-treated cells were analyzed in vitro, using two choriocarcinoma cell lines (BeWo and SCH). HCG and beta-HCG in medium were measured with a radioimmunoassay kit, and 3H-MTX,-thymidine, and-uridine with a liquid scintillation counter. The following results were obtained. The MTX resistant cell line of BeWo, named BeWo, was selected by continuous exposure to increasing concentration of MTX in culture medium. The resistant cell was 50 to 100 times as resistant to MTX as the parent BeWo to the inhibition of cell growth and the development of resistance was accompanied by two-third decrease in 3H-MTX transport. The cytotoxicity of MTX and Act-D were found to increase linearly with the drug dose for concentrations between 10(-9) and 10(-4)M, 10(-10) and 10(-7)M, respectively. Act-D caused lethal damage in three choriocarcinoma cells (BeWo, SCH and BeWo) at one-thousandths the concentration of MTX. Citrovorum factor given within twelve hours following the start of methotrexate administration decreased in 3H-MTX transport and inhibited MTX-induced growth.
abstract_ja: ヒト絨毛癌細胞株2種(BeWoおよびSCH)を用い、メトトレキサート(MTX)とアクチノマイシンD(Act-D)の細胞傷害性、およびMTX処理細胞に対するシトロボラムファクターの影響をin vitroで解析した。結果は以下のとおりである。MTX耐性のBeWo株は、培養液中でMTX濃度を段階的に上げながら連続曝露することで選択された。この耐性株は親株BeWoに比べて細胞増殖抑制に対して50〜100倍耐性であり、耐性獲得にはMTXの輸送(3H-MTXの取り込み)が3分の2に減少することが伴っていた。MTXおよびAct-Dの細胞傷害性は、それぞれ10^-9〜10^-4M、10^-10〜10^-7Mの濃度範囲で薬剤量に比例して増加した。Act-Dは、MTXの千分の一の濃度で3種の絨毛癌細胞(BeWo、SCH、およびMTX耐性BeWo)に致死的な傷害を与えた。MTX投与開始後12時間以内に投与されたシトロボラムファクターは、3H-MTXの輸送を減少させ、MTXによる増殖抑制を阻害した。
